description: Full-budget smnist BRF reproduction and paired graded-emission comparison. Four arms, five seeds; original architecture and training budget; select by fixed held-out validation loss. Scheduler shard: graded_static, all five seeds.
decision_rule: Require an explained BRF reproduction before interpreting alternatives. Report every seed, paired differences, event rate, payload scale and failures; no checkpoint selection from test accuracy.

cost.estimate_basis: Full original epoch/update budget times measured median training batch latency, with validation and setup allowance. Split into four per-arm scheduler jobs.
